It can not only enhance the holder's prestige, but also remind him that his responsibilities do not belong entirely to private families; the people in the border areas are more concerned about whether the guardian can really guard the roads and seas

Entry Wardens Titles such as Guardian of the North and Guardian of the East essentially connote defense and entrustment of royal power. It can not only enhance the holder's prestige, but also remind him that his responsibilities do not belong entirely to private families; the people in the border areas are more concerned about whether the guardian can really guard the roads and seas. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.

Entry Wardens Titles such as Guardian of the North and Guardian of the East essentially connote defense and entrustment of royal power. It can not only enhance the holder's prestige, but also remind him that his responsibilities do not belong entirely to private families; the people in the border areas are more concerned about whether the guardian can really guard the roads and seas. If a rule is practiced over and over again, it will find its way into rituals, crafts, and prayers; if it is sustained only by fear, cracks will show at the onset of a crisis.

It can not only enhance the holder's prestige, but also remind him that his responsibilities do not belong entirely to private families; the people in the border areas are more concerned about whether the guardian can really guard the roads and seas. They remember taxes, grain, labor, relief and who can speak for them; these grand names will eventually fall on the family's rice pot.
